summary: Barbour County, AL fire tower site listed with the Alabama Forestry Commission; the register says only the stands remain, and no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Only the stands remain, according to the register

events.note: Registered September 15, 2019; nominated by Andrew Zerbe

evidence.supports: tower found on Alabama Forestry Commission list
Alabama Forestry Commission administers the site
location found on a topographic map
TopoQuest name Gilmore Hill Lookout Tower, Barbour County, coordinates
evidence.quote: Gilmore Hill Lookout Tower is a tower located in Barbour County, AL at N31.877939
at an elevation of 501 ft MSL

resolved_conflicts.explanation: TopoQuest spells the name Gilmore Hill at nearly the same coordinates as the register; the register's spelling is used here

notes_for_editor: Only two sources: the FFLOS entry and a TopoQuest map-name listing. The TopoQuest 'Tower' label is a map feature name, not a check on what stands. Elevation disagrees: register 551 ft (168 m), TopoQuest 501 ft MSL; the record's 167.9 m follows the register. No build date, design, staffing, fires or access found. Access is unknown; the Alabama Forestry Commission is the place to ask whether the land is public.
